Tests that a request is rejected when budget is exceeded

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
    let _client = try createClientFromJson(json: "{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"budget\":{\"enforcement\":\"hard\",\"global_limit\":0.0}}")
    _ = try await _client.chat(_req)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
